about: Hand-labelled (claim, quote, source) triples for measuring whether the grounding gate can tell a supporting quote from a misattributed one. Every quote here is verbatim in its source, so the old substring-only gate accepts all of them; the label is the human judgement of whether the quote actually supports the claim. Written by hand for this repo, not sampled from live traffic: it is a fixed regression set, not an estimate of field accuracy.
